marta: Ok team — MerchantX kickoff in 1hr. They want a 48h POC to prove switching from CompetitorBlue. Scope: compat shim for inline tool calls, streaming parity, 220-prompt diff, short reserved pricing vs hosted, completed security Q. cc @liam @noor
liam: I'll build a non-invasive proxy shim. CompetitorBlue uses inline markers like {{CALL:refund id=99}}. Plan: regex->structured call, keep toggle. Proto by EOD.
noor: I'll run a 220 prompt diff (mix chat, long instructions, multi-tool). Two modes: default and deterministic (temp=0 + strict stops). ETA 5h for first CSV.
evan: Pricing note: need per-token vs per-request and a 2-week dedicated pro-forma. I'll pull numbers and sample invoice.
legal-bot: Security form: https://redwood.example.com/secforms/merchantx-2401. Requests: SAML, BYO-KMS, VPC, audit logs >=90d. Legal will review KMS clause.
infra-team: Can provision VPC peering after CIDR & billing code. ~24h turn.
marta: Owners: shim=liam, diff=noor, pricing=evan, security=legal-bot, infra=infra-team. Include before/after mapping example in POC deck and a small demo of token delta. Reconvene after diff upload. :thumbsup:
